caption:
This morning: Voxtral 3 made the case that voice is getting better, and the real production bottleneck is the workflow around it.

Three extra numbers: independent ranking shows 2.1% WER and a #3 spot. Live transcription is $0.006 per minute, level with OpenAI and below Gemini’s published blended rate. One recent developer comparison lists 13 streaming languages for Voxtral Realtime versus 85+ for Gemini.

My take: better voice is useful, but workflow still decides whether this becomes an operation or stays a demo.

Comment SDR and I will send you the details by DM.

Sources in the first comment.

scenes: This morning was about Voxtral 3 pushing voice closer to production with one real-time pipeline for listening, reasoning, tools, and speech. I went back in to check the numbers that matter around that launch.
First, the independent score is 2.1% word error rate, which puts Voxtral Small 3 in third place, not alone at the top.
Second, on live transcription price, Voxtral sits at $0.006 a minute, level with OpenAI and below Gemini’s published blended rate.
Third, one recent developer comparison lists Voxtral Realtime at 13 streaming languages versus 85 plus for Gemini, so language coverage is still a selection filter.
My take: better voice helps, but production wins when the model, tools, rules, and measurement all hold together.
